sort.title_vi: Mỗi cụm cần who, which hay whose?

groups.name: who
items: my aunt, ___ lives in Đà Nẵng

groups.name: which
items: the phone ___ I bought last week

groups.name: whose
items: a girl ___ dad is a pilot
the neighbour ___ cat sleeps in our garden

unjumble.sentence: Nam is the boy whose sister plays for our team.
This is the park where we often play badminton.
I trust friends who keep their promises.
My grandfather, who is very generous, loves helping others.
unjumble.hint_vi: Mệnh đề không xác định nằm giữa hai dấu phẩy

unjumble.sentence: The person that I look up to most is my aunt.
unjumble.hint_vi: that trong mệnh đề xác định + look up to

truefalse.s: Mr Hải, that teaches us PE, is very strict.
truefalse.fix: Mr Hải, who teaches us PE, is very strict.
truefalse.why_vi: Sau dấu phẩy (mệnh đề không xác định) không dùng that; nói về người thì dùng who.

truefalse.s: The girl who sits behind me always shares her pencils.
truefalse.fix: The girl who sits behind me always shares her pencils.
truefalse.why_vi: who thay cho người (the girl); mệnh đề xác định nên không có dấu phẩy.

truefalse.s: This is the house which my grandparents live.
truefalse.fix: This is the house where my grandparents live.
truefalse.why_vi: Sau chỗ trống là câu đủ ý (my grandparents live) và thay cho nơi chốn → where.

truefalse.s: I know a boy who father is a pilot.
truefalse.fix: I know a boy whose father is a pilot.
truefalse.why_vi: 'father của cậu bé' là sở hữu → whose + danh từ.

truefalse.s: The cake that Lan made was delicious.
truefalse.fix: The cake that Lan made was delicious.
truefalse.why_vi: that thay cho vật trong mệnh đề xác định (không dấu phẩy) là đúng.

truefalse.s: Đà Lạt, which is famous for its flowers, is cool all year round.
truefalse.fix: Đà Lạt, which is famous for its flowers, is cool all year round.
truefalse.why_vi: which thay cho địa danh làm chủ ngữ (which is famous…), đặt giữa hai dấu phẩy.

truefalse.s: The man which helped us was very kind.
truefalse.fix: The man who helped us was very kind.
truefalse.why_vi: the man là người → who (hoặc that), không dùng which.

truefalse.s: We visited the school where my mum used to teach.
truefalse.fix: We visited the school where my mum used to teach.
truefalse.why_vi: where thay cho nơi chốn (the school), sau đó là câu đầy đủ.

exam.intro_vi: Đề chuyên Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có 4 câu tìm từ trái nghĩa: mỗi câu có một từ hoặc cụm từ VIẾT HOA, em chọn A, B, C hoặc D có nghĩa NGƯỢC lại.
exam.tip_vi: Mẹo: đề luôn cài một từ ĐỒNG nghĩa để bẫy. Hiểu nghĩa từ in hoa trong câu trước, rồi mới tìm từ ngược nghĩa.

items.q: Linh was very PATIENT with her little brother while he was learning to read.
items.explain_vi: patient (kiên nhẫn) >< impatient (thiếu kiên nhẫn). 'calm', 'gentle' gần nghĩa, không phải trái nghĩa.

items.q: All my classmates SUPPORTED my idea for the class trip.
items.explain_vi: support (ủng hộ) >< oppose (phản đối). 'agreed with' là đồng nghĩa – bẫy!

items.q: Minh felt CONFIDENT before his speaking test because he had practised a lot.
items.explain_vi: confident (tự tin) >< nervous (lo lắng, hồi hộp).

items.q: Most students TRUST Ms Hoa because she always keeps her promises.
items.explain_vi: trust (tin tưởng) >< doubt (nghi ngờ). 'rely on', 'believe in' gần nghĩa với trust.

items.q: Mai and her best friend ARGUE about small things almost every day.
items.explain_vi: argue (cãi nhau) >< agree (đồng ý, nhất trí). 'quarrel', 'disagree' cùng nghĩa với argue.

exam.intro_vi: Đề chuyên Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có 5 câu nối câu: cho hai câu, em chọn A, B, C hoặc D là câu nối đúng và giữ nguyên nghĩa. Mệnh đề quan hệ là cách nối gặp rất nhiều.
exam.tip_vi: Mẹo: loại ngay đáp án có 'that' sau dấu phẩy, đáp án lặp lại đại từ (him, it, there) và đáp án dùng sai who/which/whose/where.

items.q: Mr Tùng is our new neighbour. His dog barks all night.
options: Mr Tùng, whose dog barks all night, is our new neighbour.
Mr Tùng, who dog barks all night, is our new neighbour.
Mr Tùng, that his dog barks all night, is our new neighbour.
Mr Tùng, whose his dog barks all night, is our new neighbour.
items.explain_vi: His dog → whose dog (sở hữu). Không thêm 'his' sau whose, không dùng that sau dấu phẩy.

items.q: Đà Nẵng is a beautiful city. I spent my summer holiday there.
options: Đà Nẵng, which I spent my summer holiday, is a beautiful city.
Đà Nẵng, where I spent my summer holiday, is a beautiful city.
Đà Nẵng, that I spent my summer holiday there, is a beautiful city.
Đà Nẵng, where I spent my summer holiday there, is a beautiful city.
items.explain_vi: there (ở đó) → where. Đã dùng where thì bỏ 'there'; dùng which thì phải có 'in'.

items.q: The girl is very honest. She found my wallet.
options: The girl which found my wallet is very honest.
The girl, that found my wallet, is very honest.
The girl found my wallet who is very honest.
The girl who found my wallet is very honest.
items.explain_vi: She → who, đặt ngay sau 'the girl'. Mệnh đề xác định nên không có dấu phẩy.

items.q: The film made me cry. I watched it last night.
options: The film which I watched it last night made me cry.
The film who I watched last night made me cry.
The film which I watched last night made me cry.
The film I watched last night it made me cry.
items.explain_vi: it → which (vật). Đã có which thì bỏ 'it'; who chỉ dùng cho người.

items.q: Hùng's father is a firefighter. Everyone in our street looks up to him.
options: Hùng's father, that everyone in our street looks up to, is a firefighter.
Hùng's father, who everyone in our street looks up to, is a firefighter.
Hùng's father, who everyone in our street looks up to him, is a firefighter.
Hùng's father, whose everyone in our street looks up to, is a firefighter.
items.explain_vi: him → who (giới từ 'to' vẫn đứng cuối). Không dùng that sau dấu phẩy, không lặp lại 'him'.

exam_easy.intro_vi: Đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có 4 câu tìm từ trái nghĩa. Em tìm từ VIẾT HOA trong câu, rồi chọn A, B, C hoặc D có nghĩa NGƯỢC lại với từ đó.
exam_easy.tip_vi: Mẹo: nhiều từ trái nghĩa chỉ cần thêm un- hoặc dis- (kind → unkind). Cẩn thận: đề hay cài một từ CÙNG nghĩa để bẫy.

items.q: My grandfather is a very KIND man. He helps everyone in our street.
items.explain_vi: kind (tốt bụng) >< unkind (không tốt bụng, ác). 'nice' cùng nghĩa với kind – đó là bẫy.

items.q: Nam is a LAZY student. He never does his homework.
items.explain_vi: lazy (lười biếng) >< hard-working (chăm chỉ).

items.q: Lan always feels HAPPY when she is with her best friends.
items.explain_vi: happy (vui) >< sad (buồn). 'glad' cũng có nghĩa là vui – cùng nghĩa, không phải trái nghĩa.

items.q: My little brother is very NOISY when he plays with his friends.
items.explain_vi: noisy (ồn ào) >< quiet (yên lặng). 'loud' (to, ồn) cùng nghĩa với noisy.

items.q: Minh is always POLITE to older people.
items.explain_vi: polite (lễ phép, lịch sự) >< rude (thô lỗ, vô lễ).

exam_easy.intro_vi: Đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có câu nối câu. Em đọc hai câu ngắn rồi chọn câu nối bằng who, which, where hoặc whose sao cho đúng ngữ pháp và giữ nguyên nghĩa.
exam_easy.tip_vi: Mẹo: người → who; vật → which; nơi chốn → where; 'của ai' → whose. Đã dùng who/which/where thì bỏ he, she, it, there.

items.q: I have a friend. She lives in Đà Lạt.
options: I have a friend which lives in Đà Lạt.
I have a friend where lives in Đà Lạt.
I have a friend who lives in Đà Lạt.
I have a friend who she lives in Đà Lạt.
items.explain_vi: She là người → thay bằng who. Đã có who thì bỏ 'she'. which dùng cho vật, where dùng cho nơi chốn.

items.q: I love the bag. My grandma gave it to me.
options: I love the bag which my grandma gave me.
I love the bag which my grandma gave it to me.
I love the bag who my grandma gave me.
I love the bag where my grandma gave me.
items.explain_vi: it là vật (the bag) → thay bằng which và bỏ 'it'. who chỉ dùng cho người.

items.q: This is the library. I meet my friends there.
options: This is the library which I meet my friends.
This is the library who I meet my friends.
This is the library where I meet my friends there.
This is the library where I meet my friends.
items.explain_vi: there (ở đó) là nơi chốn → thay bằng where và bỏ 'there'.

items.q: The man is my uncle. He is wearing a red hat.
options: The man which is wearing a red hat is my uncle.
The man who is wearing a red hat is my uncle.
The man is wearing a red hat who is my uncle.
The man who is wearing a red hat he is my uncle.
items.explain_vi: He = the man (người) → who, đặt ngay sau 'the man'. Không thêm 'he' nữa.

items.q: Lan has an uncle. His job is very interesting.
options: Lan has an uncle who job is very interesting.
Lan has an uncle which job is very interesting.
Lan has an uncle whose job is very interesting.
Lan has an uncle whose his job is very interesting.
items.explain_vi: His job (công việc của chú ấy) là sở hữu → whose job. Không thêm 'his' sau whose.

exam_plus.intro_vi: Câu trái nghĩa phân loại trong đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ thường dùng thành ngữ, cụm động từ và tính từ B2 chỉ tính cách. Bẫy quen thuộc là từ đồng nghĩa hoặc từ chỉ cùng chủ đề.
exam_plus.tip_vi: Mẹo: hiểu nghĩa cả cụm (tight-fisted, on good terms) trong ngữ cảnh, gạch bỏ các từ đồng nghĩa trước rồi mới tìm nghĩa ngược lại.

items.q: Although they sometimes disagree, Hùng and his stepfather have always been ON GOOD TERMS.
items.explain_vi: on good terms (quan hệ tốt) >< at odds (bất hoà, mâu thuẫn). 'on the same wavelength', 'close' gần nghĩa; 'in touch' = giữ liên lạc.

items.q: Mr Bình is so TIGHT-FISTED that he never even buys his friends a cup of coffee.
items.explain_vi: tight-fisted (keo kiệt) >< generous (hào phóng). 'stingy' là từ đồng nghĩa – bẫy.

items.q: Hoa is a RELIABLE friend; she has never once let me down.
items.explain_vi: reliable (đáng tin cậy) >< untrustworthy (không đáng tin). 'dependable' đồng nghĩa với reliable.

items.q: The new student was rather RESERVED at first, but after a few weeks she was chatting with everyone.
items.explain_vi: reserved (kín đáo, ít nói) >< outgoing (cởi mở, hướng ngoại). 'shy' gần nghĩa với reserved.

items.q: It's wrong to LOOK DOWN ON people just because they have less money than you.
items.explain_vi: look down on (coi thường) >< look up to (kính trọng). 'despise', 'make fun of' cùng hướng nghĩa coi thường.

exam_plus.intro_vi: Câu nối khó trong đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ dùng giới từ + whom/which, cụm 'all of whom', 'which' thay cho cả mệnh đề và whose cho vật. Các phương án thường chỉ khác nhau một từ.
exam_plus.tip_vi: Mẹo: sau giới từ chỉ dùng whom (người) hoặc which (vật), không dùng who hay that. 'which' thay cả mệnh đề trước, đứng sau dấu phẩy.

items.q: I have three cousins. All of them are older than me.
options: I have three cousins, all of them who are older than me.
I have three cousins, all of who are older than me.
I have three cousins, all of whom are older than me.
I have three cousins, that all are older than me.
items.explain_vi: all of them → all of whom (sau giới từ 'of' dùng whom). Không dùng who sau giới từ, không dùng that sau dấu phẩy.

items.q: Ms Lan is the teacher. I can always turn to her for advice.
options: Ms Lan is the teacher to whom I can always turn for advice.
Ms Lan is the teacher whom I can always turn for advice.
Ms Lan is the teacher to whom I can always turn to for advice.
Ms Lan is the teacher to that I can always turn for advice.
items.explain_vi: turn to sb = tìm đến ai để nhờ giúp. Đưa 'to' lên trước: to whom. Không bỏ mất 'to', không lặp 'to', không dùng 'to that'.

items.q: Nam forgot his best friend's birthday. This upset her a lot.
options: Nam forgot his best friend's birthday, that upset her a lot.
Nam forgot his best friend's birthday, what upset her a lot.
Nam forgot his best friend's birthday, who upset her a lot.
Nam forgot his best friend's birthday, which upset her a lot.
items.explain_vi: 'This' chỉ cả sự việc Nam quên sinh nhật → dùng ', which' thay cho cả mệnh đề trước. Không dùng that/what ở vị trí này.

items.q: We visited an old family house. Its walls were covered in photos of our ancestors.
options: We visited an old family house which walls were covered in photos of our ancestors.
We visited an old family house whose walls were covered in photos of our ancestors.
We visited an old family house whose its walls were covered in photos of our ancestors.
We visited an old family house where its walls were covered in photos of our ancestors.
items.explain_vi: Its walls → whose walls (whose dùng được cho cả vật). Không thêm 'its' sau whose.

items.q: The village is very peaceful. My grandparents live in it.
options: The village in which my grandparents live is very peaceful.
The village which my grandparents live is very peaceful.
The village in where my grandparents live is very peaceful.
The village in that my grandparents live is very peaceful.
items.explain_vi: live in it → in which (giới từ + which). Thiếu 'in' là sai; không dùng 'in where' hay 'in that'.

paper_plus.instruction_vi: Câu 1–2: viết dạng đúng của từ in hoa (có thể phải đổi từ 2 lần hoặc thêm tiền tố). Câu 3–4: viết tiếp câu thứ hai sao cho nghĩa không đổi. Câu 5–6: khoanh A, B, C hoặc D.

items.q: Most teenagers want more ______ from their parents; they like making their own decisions. (DEPEND)
Mai kept checking her watch and tapping her foot ______; her best friend was already half an hour late. (PATIENT)
I admire my grandfather more than anyone else. → The person ______
items.answer: I admire most is my grandfather.
accept: I admire most is my grandfather
I admire the most is my grandfather.
I admire the most is my grandfather
who I admire most is my grandfather.
who I admire most is my grandfather
whom I admire most is my grandfather.
whom I admire most is my grandfather
that I admire most is my grandfather.
that I admire most is my grandfather
who I admire the most is my grandfather.
whom I admire the most is my grandfather.
that I admire the most is my grandfather.

items.q: My best friend wants to become a nurse. Her parents are both doctors. → My best friend, ______
items.answer: whose parents are both doctors, wants to become a nurse.
accept: whose parents are both doctors, wants to become a nurse

items.q: Lan is outgoing and loves music, just like her mother – she really ______ her.
Nam and Huy argue now and then, but they have been as thick as ______ since primary school.

reading_gloss: bị ốm (quá khứ của fall ill)
writing_starters: The person I look up to most is …, who …

part1.intro_vi: Nghe Anna và Tom nói về một bức ảnh chụp ở tiệc sinh nhật. Chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi câu hỏi.

script.t: Hi Anna. Is that a photo from your birthday party?
Yes, it is. Look, that's my best friend, Mai. She's the girl who is holding the cake.
She looks really friendly. What's she like?
She's very generous. She always shares her snacks with everyone, and she gave me a lovely book for my birthday.
And who's the boy with glasses? He's laughing.
That's Nam. He's the boy whose dog is in the photo too. He's really funny.
Do you get on well with him?
Yes, but we sometimes argue about football! He supports a different team from me.
Ha! That sounds fun. Where was the party?
At a pizza restaurant near my house. It's the place where we always celebrate birthdays in our family.

items.q: What is Mai doing in the photo?
items.explain_vi: Anna: "She's the girl who is holding the cake."

items.q: What is Mai like?
items.explain_vi: "She's very generous. She always shares her snacks." Funny là Nam.

items.q: Which is true about Nam?
options: His dog is in the photo.
items.explain_vi: "He's the boy whose dog is in the photo too."

items.q: What do Anna and Nam sometimes argue about?
items.explain_vi: "We sometimes argue about football! He supports a different team."

items.q: Where was the party?
items.explain_vi: "At a pizza restaurant near my house." Không phải ở nhà Anna.

part2.intro_vi: Nghe một bạn học sinh nói về người bạn ấy kính trọng. Điền vào mỗi chỗ trống MỘT hoặc HAI từ, hoặc một con số.
part2.script: Hello, everyone. Today I'm going to talk about a person I really look up to. It's my grandfather, who lives with my family in Hanoi. He is 75 years old. Before he stopped working, he was a teacher at a village school. He is kind and very honest. He always tells me the truth, even when it's difficult. Every morning, he gets up early and goes for a walk in the park, where he meets his old friends. In the evening, he helps me with my maths homework. He taught me something very important: always respect other people, young or old. I love him very much, and I want to be like him.
part2.text:
A PERSON I LOOK UP TO
• Who: my [1]
• Age: [2]
• Old job: a teacher at a [3] school
• Every morning: goes for a walk in the [4]
• In the evening: helps me with my [5] homework

accept: grandpa
items.explain_vi: "It's my grandfather, who lives with my family."

accept: seventy five
items.explain_vi: "He is 75 years old."
"He was a teacher at a village school."

accept: the park
items.explain_vi: "Goes for a walk in the park, where he meets his old friends."

accept: math
items.explain_vi: "He helps me with my maths homework."

part1.intro_vi: Nghe Linh kể với Nam về chuyện cãi nhau với bạn thân. Chọn đáp án đúng cho mỗi câu hỏi.

script.t: Linh, you look upset. Is everything OK?
Not really. I had an argument with Mai yesterday.
With Mai? But you two never argue. What happened?
Well, I told her a secret about my older sister, and she told someone else. At first, I thought she'd told the whole class, but actually she only told Anna.
Still, I understand why you're angry. Trust is really important between friends.
Exactly. Now I don't know if I can trust her again. We've been best friends since we were six.
Has she said sorry to you yet?
She sent me a long message last night, but I haven't answered it yet.
Well, Mai is someone who is usually very honest. Maybe she didn't realise it was a secret.
Hmm, maybe. I did tell her at lunchtime, when everyone around us was chatting.
So why don't you talk to her face to face after school? Messages can be confusing.
You're right. I'll find her in the library, where she always studies after class. Thanks, Nam. You're so sympathetic.

items.q: Why is Linh upset?
options: Her friend told someone else her secret.
Her sister was angry with her.
items.explain_vi: "I told her a secret about my older sister, and she told someone else."

items.q: Who did Mai tell?
items.explain_vi: Linh tưởng Mai kể cả lớp, nhưng "actually she only told Anna".

items.q: How has Mai tried to say sorry?
options: She talked to Linh at lunchtime.
items.explain_vi: "She sent me a long message last night, but I haven't answered it yet."

items.q: Why does Nam think Mai may not be completely to blame?
options: Anna asked her about the secret.
She might not have known it was a secret.
She was too busy to listen.
items.explain_vi: Nam: "Maybe she didn't realise it was a secret." Linh kể lúc ồn ào giờ ăn trưa.

items.q: What will Linh do next?
options: ask Anna to keep the secret
items.explain_vi: Nam khuyên nói chuyện trực tiếp; Linh: "I'll find her in the library."

part2.intro_vi: Nghe thầy Brown giới thiệu chương trình Bạn đồng hành cho học sinh mới. Điền vào mỗi chỗ trống MỘT hoặc HAI từ, hoặc một con số.
part2.script: Good morning, everyone. I'm Mr Brown, and I'd like to tell you about our new Buddy Programme. It's for students who have just joined our school and don't know anyone yet. Each new student will have a buddy, an older student who can show them around and answer their questions. We're looking for buddies in grade 8, not grade 9, because grade 9 students need time for their exams. A good buddy is someone who is friendly, patient and, most importantly, sympathetic. You don't need to be the best student in your class. Buddies will meet their new friends twice a week, at lunchtime, in the school library. Oh, sorry, there's a change. Because the library is being painted, the meetings will be in the music room this month. If you'd like to join, please write your name on the list on the door of Room 12 before Friday. Every buddy will also get a free trip to the science museum in May. Thank you!
part2.text:
BUDDY PROGRAMME
• Buddies must be in grade [1]
• Most important quality: [2]
• Meetings: [3] a week, at lunchtime
• Meeting place this month: the [4] room
• To join: write your name on the list on the door of Room [5]

accept: eight
items.explain_vi: "We're looking for buddies in grade 8, not grade 9."
"Friendly, patient and, most importantly, sympathetic."
"Buddies will meet their new friends twice a week."

accept: music room
items.explain_vi: Thư viện đang sơn, "the meetings will be in the music room this month".

accept: twelve
items.explain_vi: "Write your name on the list on the door of Room 12."

part1.intro_vi: Nghe Anna và Tom bàn nên bầu ai làm lớp trưởng. Chú ý ý kiến, thái độ và sự thay đổi quyết định.

script.t: Tom, we're voting for the new class monitor tomorrow. Have you decided who to vote for?
I was going to choose Nam. He's the one who organised the class trip last year, and everyone gets on well with him.
True, he's really popular. But do you remember that trip? He made every decision himself and never asked for anyone else's opinion.
Hmm, that's a fair point. He can be a bit bossy. But he's confident, and a monitor has to speak in front of the teachers.
Sure, but confidence isn't everything. I'm thinking of voting for Mai.
Mai? She's so quiet, though. I've hardly ever heard her speak in class.
She's quiet, but she's the person everyone goes to when they have a problem. When my grandmother was in hospital, she was the only one who noticed I was sad.
Really? I didn't know that.
And she's completely honest. Remember when our teacher gave the class extra points by mistake? Mai was the one who told her.
Oh yes, some people were really annoyed with her! But I suppose that's exactly why people trust her.
Exactly. A monitor should be someone that the class respects, not just someone who's good at talking.
I see what you mean. But do you think she'd even want the job?
I asked her yesterday. She was nervous, but she said she'd do it if her classmates supported her.
Well, in that case, she's got my vote. Let's tell the others at lunch.

part2.intro_vi: Nghe chương trình radio về chuyện tuổi teen cãi nhau với bố mẹ. Điền vào mỗi chỗ trống MỘT hoặc HAI từ, hoặc một con số.
part2.script: Welcome back to Teen Talk. Today's topic is something which almost every family experiences: arguments between teenagers and their parents. A recent survey of 500 students in Hanoi found that most teenagers argue with their parents about three times a week. Many people expect the main cause to be school results, but in fact, the most common topic was screen time, followed by housework. Interestingly, the students who argued least were not the ones whose parents were the strictest. They were the ones who ate dinner with their family most evenings, because they had more chances to talk calmly. So what can you do? Our expert, Doctor Anna White, whose book on family relationships came out last year, has three suggestions. First, choose the right moment. Don't start a serious conversation when your parents have just come home from work. Second, listen before you answer, even if you disagree. And third, don't try to win. She says the aim of a discussion is understanding, not victory. If both sides feel respected, trust grows naturally. That's all for today. Next week, we'll be talking about online friendships.
